extras: Manual installation is currently the only supported method.
intentEvidence: This plugin complements the default Obsidian keyboard shortcuts for switching tabs (Ctrl/Cmd 1-8, 9 selects the last tab) by adding tab number 'hints'.
problem: Users may struggle to quickly identify and navigate to specific tabs when relying solely on keyboard shortcuts.
summary: Tab Numbers displays numbered badges (1-8) on Obsidian tabs when Ctrl or Cmd is held, providing visual hints for keyboard navigation.
